title: The Accord tilter high back chair
body_html:
An award-winning tilter designed by Zooey Chu — the chair that makes a boardroom look as considered as the decisions made in it.

The Global Accord is a classic-styled high-back knee-tilter built for meeting rooms, boardrooms, and private offices. Its sling-style back — upholstered with rolled-and-pleated detailing in fabric, vinyl, or fine Italian leather, or specified in breathable mesh — pairs with finely detailed polished aluminum arms and base. Soft Descent™ pneumatic lift, tilt-tension and multi-position tilt-lock deliver everyday comfort, and it's rated for users up to 300 lbs, built in Canada, and backed by Global's Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Key features

  • Award-winning Accord series, designed by Zooey Chu
  • Sling-style back in fabric, vinyl, Italian leather, or breathable mesh
  • Soft Descent™ pneumatic seat-height adjustment
  • Tilt-tension adjustment and multi-position tilt-lock
  • Knee-tilt movement with waterfall seat edge and contoured cushions
  • Self-skinned urethane (SSU) armcaps, warm to the touch
  • Polished cast-aluminum fixed loop arms and five-prong base
  • Dual-wheel casters (carpet or hardwood); 360° swivel
  • Rated for users up to 300 lbs (8-hr day, 40-hr week)
  • GREENGUARD Gold and BIFMA LEVEL 3 certified

Who it's for

Meeting rooms, boardrooms, and private offices that want a design-forward, award-winning tilter in leather, vinyl, fabric, or mesh — where appearance matters as much as everyday ergonomic comfort.

Brant Business Interiors carries the Global Accord and delivers across Ontario, with installation available. Call 1-800-835-9565 to choose your back height, upholstery, base, and OECM pricing.
